paper.title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model

primary_source_findings.fact: Critic regresses GAE returns computed from imagined transitions only; each rollout target stays fixed during fitting. No EMA target critic.
lambda=0.95, gamma=0.99, critic fitting 5 epochs x 4 minibatches per update.
Critic hidden widths 256,128; listed inputs are imagined state, goal and simulation context. Ten-frame observation history is explicitly listed for policy decoder, not critic.
Both critic and critic-free H=8 variants fail to reach target training return 0.82 on LAFAN1. With critic, H=16 matches critic-free H=32; default H=32 reaches target fastest.
World-model fitting window k=8 and actor imagination horizon H=32 are different settings.

current_code_differences.critic_targets: Complete physical Monte Carlo returns; critic not fit on actor imagined state/history distribution.
current_code_differences.critic_input: Adds explicit previous action and flattened 990-dimensional history.
current_code_differences.horizon: H=8 rather than paper H=32; k=8 unchanged.
current_code_differences.task: Reference-free fullbody standing/aiming, unlike full-reference motion tracking.

corrections_to_prior_advice: Paired physical perturbation supervision is an experimental proposal, not a mechanism established by SuperMimic.
gamma=0.99 is also the original paper setting, so it is not on its own evidence of a configuration bug.
Observed critic gradient failures do not establish inadequate network capacity as the cause.
H=8 is not supported as a successful default by the cited paper sweep; this does not prove it cannot work on this different standing task.
inferences_to_test: Fitting only on physical trajectories while differentiating at predicted states can leave the actor input neighborhood insufficiently calibrated.
Additional history/previous-action input paths deserve an isolated comparison, given measured gradient dominance.
actions: Read-only paper/code comparison. Active training and parameters unchanged.
